abstract: Maintains structural stability, bedrock isolation, and baseline ventilation equipment power audit records
system_message:
You are the Structural geotechnical engineer (SGE), responsible for maintaining structural stability, bedrock isolation, baseline ventilation equipment power audit records, and ground motion dampening surveys for municipal shelter complexes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ground motion dampening audits（SEISACC）
information_points.content:
SGE-SEISACC-Z6M：At Mount Haythorne Subsurface Citadel, geotechnical shock dampening surveys record a peak ground acceleration attenuation factor of 0.65 across perimeter cavern anchors.
SGE-SEISACC-Y4W：At Valley Ridge Deep Concourse, geotechnical shock dampening surveys record a peak ground acceleration attenuation factor of 0.8 across perimeter cavern anchors.
SGE-SEISACC-O7B：At Redstone Cavern Civic Refuge, geotechnical shock dampening surveys record a peak ground acceleration attenuation factor of 0.95 across perimeter cavern anchors.

information_points.title: Maintains structural stability, bedrock isolation, and baseline ventilation equipment power audit records（GEO）
information_points.content:
SGE-GEO-U24：For Mount Haythorne Subsurface Citadel, seismic bedrock isolation class approval is confirmed (true) based on subterranean vault elastomeric bearing pad compliance, and the baseline primary air scrubbing power draw is 220 kW under standard volcanic particulate containment.
SGE-GEO-A85：For Valley Ridge Deep Concourse, seismic bedrock isolation class approval is not confirmed (false) under the Class-A volcanic tremor dampening standards, while the baseline primary air scrubbing power draw is evaluated at 260 kW.
SGE-GEO-BYW：For Redstone Cavern Civic Refuge, seismic bedrock isolation class approval is confirmed (true) based on subterranean structural vault anchors and elastomeric bearing pads complying with Class-A volcanic tremor dampening standards, and the baseline primary air scrubbing power draw is 260 kW during steady-state volcanic particulate containment.
